defeat.condition: any configured loss condition becomes true

story_endings.title: MISSION ACCOMPLISHED
story_endings.text: The colony achieves its major objectives, maintains stable life-support systems, and establishes a sustainable foundation for future Mars exploration.

story_endings.title: MISSION SURVIVED
story_endings.text: The crew survives the 30 days, but the base suffers significant resource shortages, infrastructure damage, or incomplete scientific objectives.

story_endings.title: MISSION PAUSED
story_endings.text: Critical system failures or resource depletion force the crew to suspend operations and prioritize emergency survival procedures.

scoring.note: Each category mixes the final state (70%) with the decisions taken (score deltas in story/campaign_30_sols.json). Game balance values.
